definition: For a supplied Preorder T and designated now, the frame carrier is the subtype of times t with t=now or t<now. Accessibility from t to s means s<t. Transitivity ensures each earlier witness remains inside this past-through-now carrier. It is an inline instance of the existing Frame, not a new temporal syntax or causal relation.
note: Owner-approved bounded temporal interpretation of the existing Frame/order vocabulary; no new Lean semantic primitive. See inline frames in Modal.PastSerialityCertificate. Time points are not identified with modal alternative complete histories or causal graph vertices. No physical-past, duration or event-count claim.
